newsitem.title: USA: ICU Medical names Francis O'Brien as CFO.
newsitem.headline: ICU Medical names Francis O'Brien as CFO.

text.p: ICU Medical Inc said Friday it had appointed Francis O'Brien as its chief financial officer beginning November 1.
The company did not say who O'Brien would replace.
It also said it would begin a program to repurchase shares of its common stock from time to time.
"The repurchase program reflects the board's belief that, at current prices, the stock is undervalued," it said. "We believe it represents an attractive investment at these prices.
"Purchases at current prices will have a positive impact on earnings per share," it added.
